body:
## Pull request overview

Adds documentation describing newly supported ObjectQL advanced query features and enhanced field/driver capabilities, and updates project docs to reflect current protocol status.

**Changes:**
- Update README highlights to include Window Functions, HAVING, DISTINCT, Subqueries, Vector, and Location.
- Update `PROTOCOL_OPTIMIZATION_PLAN.md` progress/status sections to reflect the latest completion percentages.
- Add a new comprehensive completion report (`PROTOCOL_EXTENSIONS_COMPLETED.md`) with examples and references.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| README.md | Adds a “Recent Updates” section and updates Data Protocol bullets to mention the new query/field features. |
| PROTOCOL_OPTIMIZATION_PLAN.md | Updates evaluation metadata and completion scoring to reflect the new protocol capabilities. |
| PROTOCOL_EXTENSIONS_COMPLETED.md | New completion report documenting the protocol extensions, including schema snippets and usage examples. |
